mapper.select: SELECT id, product_id, sku_no, sku_name, attrs_json, image_url, sale_price, market_price, cost_amount, pv_value, bv_value, stock, sales_count, status, create_time, update_time FROM dms_shop_sku WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dms_shop_sku (product_id, sku_no, sku_name, attrs_json, image_url, sale_price, market_price, cost_amount, pv_value, bv_value, stock, sales_count, status) VALUES (#{productId}, #{skuNo}, #{skuName}, #{attrsJson}, #{imageUrl}, #{salePrice}, #{marketPrice}, #{costAmount}, #{pvValue}, #{bvValue}, #{stock}, #{salesCount}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_shop_sku SET sku_no = #{skuNo}, sku_name = #{skuName}, attrs_json = #{attrsJson}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, sale_price = #{salePrice}, market_price = #{marketPrice}, cost_amount = #{costAmount}, pv_value = #{pvValue}, bv_value = #{bvValue}, stock = #{stock}, status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE dms_shop_sku SET stock = stock - #{quantity}, sales_count = sales_count + #{quantity}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1 AND stock >= #{quantity}
UPDATE dms_shop_sku SET stock = stock + #{quantity}, sales_count = CASE WHEN sales_count >= #{quantity} THEN sales_count - #{quantity} ELSE 0 END, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
